sources.title: Python FastAPI Tutorial: Build a REST API

steps.title: Create and run basic FastAPI app
steps.instructions: Install fastapi and uvicorn, then create main.py with app = FastAPI() and a root @app.get("/") route. Run uvicorn main:app --reload and confirm the server starts.

targets.caption: Instantiate the FastAPI app and define the root GET endpoint
Confirm Uvicorn starts on port 8000 with auto-reload

hints: Make sure both fastapi and uvicorn are installed in your Python environment.
In main.py, import FastAPI from fastapi and decorate def root() with @app.get("/").
Run uvicorn main:app --reload from the directory containing main.py.
common_mistakes: Running uvicorn on the wrong module or variable name instead of main:app.
Forgetting to install uvicorn alongside fastapi.
Saving main.py in a different folder than the terminal working directory.

steps.title: Add POST endpoint to create items
steps.instructions: Create an empty items list and add an @app.post("/items") route that appends the item and returns the list. Test it from a second terminal with curl -X POST.

targets.caption: Add the POST /items endpoint to append items to the list
Uvicorn logs the POST request with status 200

explanations.topic: Accepting query parameters in a POST route

hints: Declare items = [] at module scope before defining your route handlers.
Use @app.post("/items") with def create_item(item: str): to accept the item query parameter.
Quote the URL in curl so the shell does not misinterpret the ? character.
common_mistakes: Initializing items = [] inside create_item instead of at the top level.
Forgetting to quote the URL containing ?item=... in zsh or bash.

steps.title: Add GET endpoint by item ID
steps.instructions: Add an @app.get("/items/{item_id}") handler that returns items[item_id]. POST an item, then fetch /items/0 with curl.

targets.caption: Add path parameter route to retrieve a single item by index
Uvicorn logs the GET request with status 200

explanations.topic: Path parameters and automatic type conversion

hints: Wrap item_id in curly braces in the decorator path: /items/{item_id}.
Type-annotate item_id: int in get_item so FastAPI converts the path string to an integer.
Remember that saving main.py reloads uvicorn and clears the in-memory items list, so POST an item before testing GET.
common_mistakes: Forgetting to re-add items with POST after uvicorn reloads main.py, causing an IndexError.
Omitting the int type hint on item_id, which causes list indexing with a string to fail.

steps.title: Handle missing items with HTTPException
steps.instructions: In main.py, import HTTPException from fastapi and raise a 404 when item_id >= len(items). Request a missing index with curl to see the error JSON.

targets.caption: Raise a 404 HTTPException when the requested item_id is out of bounds

explanations.topic: HTTP response status codes (404 Not Found)
Raising HTTPException with status_code and detail

hints: Import HTTPException alongside FastAPI at the top of main.py.
Check if item_id < len(items): before indexing into items.
Use raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=f"Item {item_id} not found") in the else branch.
common_mistakes: Returning HTTPException instead of raising it with raise.
Forgetting to import HTTPException from fastapi.

steps.title: Add GET items list with limit
steps.instructions: In main.py add a `@app.get("/items")` route with `limit: int = 10` returning `items[0:limit]`. Test it with `curl -X GET 'http://127.0.0.1:8000/items?limit=3'`.

targets.caption: Add GET /items endpoint with an optional limit query parameter

explanations.topic: Optional query parameters with default values and type hints

hints: Define list_items with @app.get("/items") and parameter limit: int = 10.
Slice the list using items[0:limit] and return it.
Make sure you POST a few items before testing GET /items?limit=3.
common_mistakes: Omitting the default value (= 10) on limit, making the query parameter mandatory.
Using the same HTTP method (POST) instead of GET on /items.

steps.title: Validate payloads with Pydantic BaseModel
steps.instructions: Import `BaseModel` from `pydantic`, define an `Item` model in main.py, and make `create_item` take `item: Item`. Test `POST /items` with `curl -d` and a JSON body.

targets.caption: Define the Item Pydantic model with required text and default is_done fields

explanations.topic: Benefits of Pydantic models for structured data
How Pydantic parameters expect a JSON request body
Making fields required by removing default values

hints: Import BaseModel from pydantic and subclass it with class Item(BaseModel):.
Give Item two fields: text: str (required) and is_done: bool = False.
Send the JSON payload using -d '{"text":"apple"}' instead of a ?item= query parameter.
common_mistakes: Still sending ?item=apple in the query string after changing create_item to accept Item.
Forgetting to inherit from BaseModel when defining class Item.

steps.title: Add response_model to GET decorators
steps.instructions: In main.py, add `response_model=list[Item]` to the `/items` GET decorator and `response_model=Item` to the `/items/{item_id}` GET decorator (use your own model name if it differs).

targets.caption: Add response_model arguments to the GET route decorators

hints: Pass response_model as a keyword argument inside @app.get(...).
Use response_model=list[Item] for list_items and response_model=Item for get_item.
common_mistakes: Setting response_model=Item on list_items instead of list[Item].

steps.title: Test endpoints in Swagger UI
steps.instructions: Open `http://127.0.0.1:8000/docs` in Google Chrome and expand `POST /items`. Click Try it out, edit the request body, and click Execute.

targets.caption: Interact with and execute POST /items inside Swagger UI at /docs

explanations.topic: Using FastAPI's built-in Swagger UI at /docs

hints: Navigate to http://127.0.0.1:8000/docs while uvicorn is running.
Expand the POST /items accordion and click the Try it out button.
Enter valid JSON with a "text" key and click Execute to inspect the response body.
common_mistakes: Navigating to /docs when the uvicorn server is stopped.
Entering invalid JSON syntax in the Swagger request body editor.
